2 minute stroll to Rosemary Beach! We welcome you to our beautiful beaches and luxury vacation home!
Featuring a private heated pool and only a 1 min. walk to the sugar white sand beach! Sleeps 19!

"Just Beachy" is an exquisite custom luxury 3 story home! Located in the exclusive private gated community of Waters Edge, which meets Rosemary Beach on the west side. (A quaint, one minute walk to the beach!)

Home Features
~ Private heated pool
~ 4 bikes included free with your stay (you can rent more on your own when you arrive if needed)
~ Daily cabana chair set up INCLUDED FREE! Includes 2 chairs, 1 umbrella, and cocktail table
(March 1-Nov 26 only)

~ Just steps to the magnificent sugar white sand beach, down the palm tree lined path.
~ Surround sound
~ Outdoor shower & outdoor half bath by pool
~ Propane grill
~ 5 King bedroom suites & large bunk room with 6 beds (bunk room sleeps 9)
~ Additional King bed on third floor next to the bunk room
~ Ice maker
~ 2 Dishwashers
~ Gas stove
~ Flat screen TV's in all bedrooms
~ Free Wi-Fi

With 6 large bedrooms (5 with king beds and one bunk room), seven bathrooms and 10-foot ceilings, this luxurious beach home is perfect for 19 guests to sleep and unwind in paradise.

Just Beachy is a custom designed, professionally decorated, and well equipped home to make your vacation relaxing and memorable. The home includes hairdryers, beach towels, beach chairs, cooler, pool toys, 4 bikes, and many other items to make your beach vacation complete.

Just Beachy's gourmet kitchen is a culinary delight. You'll enjoy a free-standing granite kitchen bar with seating for 4 and a second sink. Equipped with the best cookware, Keurig coffee maker, high-end appliances including 2 dishwashers, 2 ovens, a built-in wine rack, granite counter tops, stone slate back splashes, and custom cabinetry, this large kitchen is spacious and visually pleasing.

Throughout the house you will find beautiful stone and fine hardwood floors, elegant furnishings, and comfortable beds with new designer linens. Each porch is furnished so you can rest and enjoy the coastal breeze with just the right amount of shade.

Just out the tall French doors off the living area is a large covered porch with outdoor seating, a private swimming pool, hot tub, outdoor dining table and gas grill. Additionally, there is a half bath and outdoor shower for rinsing off after a day at the beach.

For the golfer, Camp Creek Golf Club is a 5-minute drive featuring a world-class Tom Fazio-designed course.

- Bunk Room, 3 Bunk Beds with Fulls on Bottom and Twins on Top (6 beds total, bunk room sleeps 9), Bathroom With Shower & Tub on 3rd floor.

Just Beachy is a remarkable brand new home. It is the newest home in Water's Edge. Guests are within walking distance to Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and Seacrest Beach.
Water's Edge is a gated secure beach community nestled entirely on the south side Of Scenic Hwy 30A providing easy beach access in just seconds. This Upscale neighborhood is located directly adjacent to Rosemary Beach community allowing easy access to the amazing little shopping and restaurants! At Water's Edge you can truly .........relax your cares away!

~Beach chair & umbrella rental is available w/ daily set up on the beach. (1 set comes free March 1-Nov 26)
~If you need more bikes, bicycle rental is available w/ free delivery to the house.
If you would like to order more than just the one included set, you can call
La Dolce Vita Beach Service at 866-651-1869.
Just tell them you are in the Water's Edge subdivision next to Rosemary Beach.
You will need this if you want to rent additional beach chairs or have them do a bonfire at https://www.ldvbeach.com/store/category/waters-edge/

Please note, the calendar is kept up to date daily.

June and July require Saturday to Saturday stays and 7 night minimums.
Easter, Thanksgiving and Christmas require 5 night minimums.

Carolyn 636-226-7873
